case_title: NANCE ARLETA VS COLLINS IRMA PATRICIA

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $1,978.67 FILED BY NANCE ARLETA AS TO DEFENDANT COLLINS IRMA PATRICIA ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR APR-26-1991 AT 08:00 AM IN DEPT 08
